title: Raw capture record
description: One raw capture, verbatim, before any interpretation runs (ADR-007 section 1). Stored under _capture/raw/, one file per record, named `<id>.json`. Raw text is never edited and never deleted by an agent (REQ-002 R2) — a correction to a derived record leaves the record here untouched. Every field an agent later fills on a staged record carries a `provenance.capture_id` (evidence.schema.json) that must resolve to a record here; that resolvability is checked by the source-reading code and its tests, not by this schema, which validates only the shape of one record in isolation.

id.description: raw-<capture time, compact UTC, YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>-<6 lowercase hex chars>. Time-prefixed so records sort chronologically by filename with no separate index; the hex suffix disambiguates two captures landing in the same second across the three concurrent channels (ADR-007 section 2), which a single incrementing counter cannot do without a shared writer. Assigned once, by whichever channel writes the record, and never reassigned. This is the format phase-cap-02's evidence.schema.json deferred to this phase.

captured_at.description: When the capture happened, RFC 3339 with a mandatory offset, mirroring idea.schema.json's `at` field for the same reason: ordering across records requires a comparable time, and a naked local time is not one. The pattern carries enforcement until phase-rel-11 turns on the `date-time` format checker; `format` stays as the declaration of intent.

channel.description: Which of the three intake channels produced this record (ADR-007 section 2). Recorded for audit only — all three channels write the same shape and are expected to converge on the same routing and evidence for the same text (REQ-002 R4).

content.description: The capture, byte-identical to what was submitted (REQ-002 R1). Never rewritten in place; a correction creates a new derived record and leaves this one exactly as captured.

source_path.description: For the inbox channel, the original file path the capture was read from, relative to _capture/inbox/. Null for the session and cli channels, which have no file of origin.
